title: Anthropic transport with separated credentials and bounded retry

outcomes.statement: Calls reach the vendor API under an endpoint-specific header policy with declared rate limits and bounded retry, and a credential routed to the wrong capability fails closed before any request is issued.
outcomes.demo: An Analytics key routed to a user-management endpoint is rejected without a request; the per-minute budget and retry ceiling are observable against deterministic fixtures with an injected clock.

uncertainties.statement: No live Anthropic credentials exist; the live provider probe is blocked on per-org keys and invite-canary authorization.
uncertainties.resolution: Scope is deterministic fixtures backed by Pact consumer contracts. Live acceptance stays gated behind the authorized provider run named in the parent story's AC4.

uncertainties.statement: The original 115-minute estimate assumed the probe supplied portable rate-limit and retry semantics. It does not: probe.ts request() only sets a fixed header set and has no limiter, no retry and no Retry-After handling. schemas.ts classifies 429 as rate_limited but never acts on it, and no rate-limit or retry machinery exists anywhere in the workspace.
uncertainties.resolution: The limiter and retry are greenfield, which is what pushes this item past the 120-minute limit and forces this partition. Recorded rather than absorbed.

uncertainties.statement: packages/connectors declares zero runtime dependencies, so a rate-limit library would be a new dependency in a deliberately dependency-free vendor-neutral package.
uncertainties.resolution: Hand-roll the limiter against an injected clock. That keeps the package dependency-free and makes the tests deterministic, which the testing standard requires anyway.

uncertainties.statement: Whether AC1's rate limiting means client-side budgets or honoring provider headers.
uncertainties.resolution: Both. AC1 names explicit client-side numbers, and the probe's SanitizedObservation already reserves response_headers.retry_after and response_headers.rate_limit, so provider-driven backoff is the established intent. Both land in the rate-limit child.

partitions.title: Endpoint-specific header policy with fail-closed credential routing
partitions.outcome: A request carries the correct endpoint header policy, and a credential routed to the wrong capability is rejected before any network call is issued.
partitions.demo: An Analytics key routed to a user-management endpoint throws before fetch is reached; an Admin key on the same endpoint issues a request carrying the expected headers.

uncertainties.statement: No live Anthropic credentials exist; the live provider probe is blocked on per-org keys and invite-canary authorization.
uncertainties.resolution: Scope is deterministic fixtures backed by Pact consumer contracts. Live acceptance stays gated behind the authorized provider run named in the parent story's AC4.

partitions.cross_cutting_rationale: AC1 bundles credential separation with rate limiting in one criterion. This child owns the credential-routing and header-policy half; the rate-limit child owns the budget and retry half. Neither alone satisfies AC1, so both declare it and AC1 is met only when both land.

partitions.title: Declared rate-limit budgets and bounded retry sharing the limiter
partitions.outcome: Requests are held to the declared per-endpoint budgets and retries are bounded and counted against the same budget, so a retry storm cannot exceed the ceiling.
partitions.demo: With an injected clock, a burst past 100/min user-management is deferred rather than issued; a retry sequence provably cannot exceed the declared per-minute ceiling; a Retry-After header is honored.

uncertainties.statement: No live Anthropic credentials exist; the live provider probe is blocked on per-org keys and invite-canary authorization.
uncertainties.resolution: Scope is deterministic fixtures backed by Pact consumer contracts. Live acceptance stays gated behind the authorized provider run named in the parent story's AC4.

uncertainties.statement: Retry must not amplify load against a rate-limited provider.
uncertainties.resolution: Retries draw from the same limiter as first attempts, asserted by a test proving a retry storm cannot exceed the declared per-minute ceiling.

uncertainties.statement: The declared limits are documented values, not measured.
uncertainties.resolution: Encoded as configuration (100/min user management, 60/min analytics, 1200 invites/hour) and asserted against fixtures. Confirming real provider behavior belongs to the gated live run.

partitions.cross_cutting_rationale: AC1 bundles rate limiting with credential separation in one criterion. This child owns the budget and bounded-retry half and is written against the transport seam the sibling delivers; AC1 is met only when both land.
